regions.merged_text: God bless you and yours. I just read your letter of yesterday which came about an hour ago and before I put it off and it gets "snowed under" with other work, I am answering it at once. As I said before I think the whole trouble comes from the fact that some one, as it seems, never receives holy communion and therefore, neither of you say the right thing or do what prudent to promote mutual confidence. You can overcome that to an extent for both by receiving all the more frequently yourself and perseveringly praying-without too much anxiety-for the our dear Lord's guidance and protection of both-and of all.
